# WebSaurus Lotties

> Eight looping animations of WebSaurus, the W2 mascot: a red dinosaur in chunky nerd glasses and a graphite W2 hoodie who holds a yellow highlighter in his tiny hand. W2 is AI for the curious. Every animation downloads as Lottie JSON, .lottie, MP4 or GIF.

## Pages
- [Preview and downloads](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/): all eight animations playing, with download buttons
- [Full details](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every animation, file link, size and the brand colours

## Animations (Lottie JSON)
- [Idle](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-idle.json): 4s full body loop, breathing, blink, smug brow
- [Hype jump](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-hype.json): 2s full body jump with a cackle in the air
- [Talk](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-talk.json): 2s head loop with a moving mouth for voiceover
- [Smug](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-smug.json): 3s head loop, the hot take face
- [Shocked](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-shocked.json): 2s head loop, the "wait, what?" face
- [Thinking](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-thinking.json): 3s head loop with thought dots
- [Cackling](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-cackling.json): 2s head loop, laughing
- [Avatar](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/lottie/websaurus-avatar.json): 3s smug loop on an ink circle for profile pictures

## Bundles
- [Everything as a zip](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/websaurus-lotties.zip): JSON, .lottie, MP4 and GIF for all eight
- [All eight in one .lottie](https://websaurus-lottie.vercel.app/exports/dotlottie/websaurus-all.lottie)
